players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce announce strategic (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce and Reliance Industries Limited announced their strategic intent to partner and offer capabilities for the design, development, manufacturing and delivery of a sovereign indigenous combat engine for India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, and will explore forming a dedicated Aerospace Gas Turbine Complex in India as a centre of excellence for power and propulsion (a statement of intent; no contract stated). CEO Tufan Erginbilgic: it 'marks a major milestone towards building a robust, self-reliant aerospace ecosystem in the country.'
